findings.commitment: Host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

findings.reason: Elva promised to host Alder's environment on Microsoft Azure, but the catalogue only supports AWS or GCP for regional cloud deployment in Australia, so Azure cannot be delivered even with an exception.

findings.commitment: Cloud provider for Alder's dedicated hosting environment

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

contract_quote.quote: Provider will host the Customer's dedicated environment on Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region.

findings.subject: environment
findings.promised_value: Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region
findings.contract_value: Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region
findings.reason: The RFP response commits to hosting on Microsoft Azure, but the Statement of Work instead commits to Amazon Web Services for the same dedicated environment, a direct conflict on cloud provider and region.
